row_semantics: One selected original numeric grid position; group-heading-only rows excluded. Continued and split tables retain actual numeric row numbering. No ranked/award or local-project rows.
identity_contract: Every cell has observation_identity_suffix=row:+source_row. Use only when nonempty for new sources, without changing old release IDs.
numbers: Exact Decimal string ornull; commas and original precision invalue_raw. Never repair malformed grouping by changing digits. Nonstandard original comma grouping is flagged.
missing_values: blank_in_source only actual empty cell; not_available_in_source only explicit marker; source_marker only literal unresolved word. Literal zero stays reported. Unexpected text rejects the batch.
units: Original printed unit, contextual interpretation basis and candidate kept separately. Mixed resource totals have no invented uniform unit. source_heading_conflict_unresolved must have nullunit.
period: Annual flows/financial amounts use source reference year Jan1-Dec31. Stock/ratio exact dates not stated remainnull; publication/access dates not substituted.
scope: Original label/order retained; county/national/national-library/private/level groups not added across overlapping scopes.
location: PDF page1-based, printed page separate. Bbox coordinates are top-left pdfplumber PDF points. Original row-label glyph signatures frozen in source specs.
jsonl_types: Original raw strings; normalized numeric strings orrealnull; integer row/column/page; nativebbox/flags arrays; original_fieldsobject.
